purpose: Compare a single explicitly locanted normal alkyl substitutive operation on an explicitly indicated-H parent; no whole identity admission.
guards: explicit locant 1 for substituent and indicated-H parent
one alkyl substituent bonded at parent N1
interpretation: The IUPAC parent locant and indicated-H define the parent hydride state before substitution.
Substitution formally exchanges one N1 hydrogen for a covalently bonded unbranched alkyl group; do not require the replaced hydrogen in the final structure.
Use independently validated numbered parent templates and exact alkyl templates, not parser atom IDs.
negative_proof: DIFFERENT only if the relevant constraint is established, the candidate is reliable and complete, and all chemically admissible correspondences violate it; graph mismatch alone is not a reason.
completeness: Operation only. Tautomer dimension and all other identity dimensions require independently justified completeness; no such result is promised here.
nonclaims: Excluded strings are not asserted chemically ambiguous.
Candidate isotope, stereo, charge, additional components or source conflict require separate assessment.
No synonym is validated by this contract alone.

R1: IUPAC Blue Book P-13.1: substitutive operation
R2: IUPAC Blue Book P-14.3.2: placement of locants
R3: IUPAC Blue Book P-14.7.1: indicated hydrogen
R4: IUPAC Blue Book P-22.2, Table 2.2: retained parent hydrides and numbering
R5: IUPAC Blue Book P-29: substituent-group names
